segments.name: Financial institution
segments.description: Provides deposit, lending and related banking services to its customers, earning interest and fees on them.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single segment entity for financial reporting purposes and has adopted ASU 2023-07 during the year ended June 30, 2025.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay fees for deposit account services, ATM and debit card use, and treasury management, and borrowers pay interest on loans.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company generates revenue from fees charged for deposit account maintenance, overdrafts, wire transfers, and check fees.
